description: The four stream cases the parity catalog adds to stream-error-frames.json. Each case is one HTTP answer: status, headers and body chunks sent verbatim ("raw") or as data frames ("sse"). Shared by the Python and TypeScript parity recorders.

source.plan: the parity case list (stream cases) and deltas D-12, D-16, D-17
source.inferred: cache_hit_json_to_stream follows chat_stream.go:211-214 (a short-circuit answers stream:true with JSON). responses_event_error uses the OpenAI Responses error event shape; the gateway's own frame is re-recorded by the live wire suite at the pin.

cases.name: cache_hit_json_to_stream
cases.about: A cache hit (or any short-circuit) answers a stream:true chat request with one JSON body instead of SSE.

cases.name: responses_event_error
cases.about: A /v1/responses stream that sends typed events, then an `event: error` frame.

cases.name: late_error_after_finish_reason
cases.about: Content, a finish_reason chunk and the gateway's usage chunk, then an error frame and [DONE]: the error comes after everything a consumer might treat as the end (D-16).

cases.name: guardrail_header_open
cases.about: A stream that opens with guardrail warning headers on the 200 answer, then streams normally.
